## Projects

- [WhatsApp Commerce Copilot](https://github.com/comebck-pakistan/cohort-1-squad-margalla/tree/main/whatsapp-commerce-copilot):
  Agentic AI copilot for Pakistani clothing-brand owners that reads customer questions in Urdu
  and Roman Urdu across WhatsApp and Instagram DMs and replies with catalog-grounded answers on
  sizing, delivery, and Cash-on-Delivery confirmation. Built in a 4-person squad during Comebck
  Pakistan Cohort 1 (8-week, YC-style accelerator); selected Top 5 of the cohort.
  Tech: Agentic AI, LLM integration, React, FastAPI, LangChain, Redis, Docker.
- [Entropy-Aware Data Preservation System](https://github.com/Sajid0875/adaptive-data-preservation):
  Production-style PostgreSQL ETL pipeline that computes Shannon entropy via automated triggers
  and routes records through rule-based preservation logic across a normalized (3NF) 10+ table
  schema, with a real-time PHP dashboard for entropy trends and audit logs.
  Tech: PostgreSQL, Python, PHP, Bootstrap, Shell.
- [Agentic Systems Bootcamp](https://github.com/Sajid0875/agentic-systems-bootcamp):
  Open-source curriculum on production AI agent architectures — LLM orchestration, multi-step
  reasoning, tool use, memory management, and RAG pipeline design. Implemented episodic memory
  using vector databases (FAISS/Chroma) with compressed summary buffers for long-horizon agents.
  Tech: Python, LangChain, OpenAI API, Anthropic API, RAG, vector databases.
- n8n AI Agent Workflow Automation: End-to-end AI agent workflows in n8n integrating LLMs with
  external APIs, webhooks, and data sources, using conditional branching, retry logic, and
  structured output parsing. Tech: n8n, REST APIs, Python, LLM integrations.
